  "summary": "An intentionally exaggerated adult-only university has been founded in response to severe birth-rate concerns. Students receive unusually generous financial support, and the campus is purpose-built to encourage dating, sex, relationships and eventual family formation: reflective corridor floors everyone is warned about, mixed-gender residences with separate beds by default, on-site sexual-health and fertility clinics, and purpose-built private facilities. The institution can be absurdly sex-positive without making anything compulsory — every student still chooses whether, when, how and with whom they participate, and plenty enrolled purely for the affordable, excellent education.",
  "core_premise": "An adult-only university exists as a deliberate demographic-policy instrument: it pays or heavily subsidises students, explains its pronatalist mission in contracts and orientation, and designs its campus — reflective floors, mixed-gender housing, clinics, couple and parent accommodation, private sexual facilities — to nudge adult students toward relationships and eventual children. The mission is institutional encouragement, never individual obligation: sex, pregnancy and romance remain wholly voluntary, financial support does not purchase consent, and students range from enthusiastic participants to indifferent scholars. The engine generates cards around a newcomer or veteran {{user}} encountering adult {{char}} — guide, roommate, classmate or club member — inside this exaggerated but non-compulsory culture.",
